Container.Name: octopus-qdrant
Container.Overview: Qdrant vector database container for self-hosted Octopus code embeddings and search.
Container.Requires: Companion vector database for Octopus. Avoid exposing Qdrant directly to the internet. If you enable QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY, set the same value as QDRANT_API_KEY in the Octopus template.

Config.Name: Qdrant HTTP Port
Config.Description: Qdrant HTTP API port. The Octopus template defaults to host.docker.internal:43333.

Config.Name: QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Qdrant API key. If set, configure QDRANT_API_KEY in Octopus to the same value.
